missionPremise: READ ONLY. For each of the six CTX counties: what CAD actually has, what production will actually serve, and what the gap is. Field list derived from information_schema and atom bodies, never hand-written. Per county, never global. Four-cell placement plus pipeline-word leak. This gates Wave R so the gap is NAMED, not closed.
completionPredicate: Per-county per-field table with four-cell placement, source and served populations, stored-zero counts on numeric fields. Gap ranked and named SOURCE vs PIPELINE. Every pipeline-word leak named with field, counties, and the basis the bake had. Serve-side store+table named and how it is what Wave R publishes. Six golds live plus one area-sweep block per county. current_database() in the first query output. leave_behind named. No mutation.
scopeBasis: Reads on hauska_mcp (atoms) and neondb (cad_property + place_layer_snapshots). Half-open entity_id FIPS ranges, never jurisdiction_tenant. Do not write, bake, stamp, or backfill. Do not collapse stored zeros into absent. Do not report served fields from code.

serveSideHypothesis.howWaveRPublishes: OPS-19 A-020: the publish job upserts place_layer_snapshots keyed by the parcel node id the serving path already uses; cortex-api loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot SELECTs adapter_key IN (node-facets:tier1, node-facets:tier2) at place_key = node:{parcelNodeId}. Wave R is a re-bake into this same table. Hypothesis is confirmed only after information_schema + a gold payload_json matches a live /facets body.
serveSideHypothesis.rejectedAlternate: Measuring the bake code or the LDT #575 reader as if it were served. Code-done is not customer-done; gold-probe already found #575 fields absent on all six live bodies.

sourceSideHypothesis.relational: neondb.public.cad_property (and any other information_schema table whose name or comment is CAD). Columns derived, not remembered.
sourceSideHypothesis.atoms: hauska_mcp.public.atoms entity_type=cad-parcel-roll, scoped by half-open entity_id FIPS ranges. Keys from jsonb_object_keys(body) DISTINCT, 100 percent.
sourceSideHypothesis.whyBoth: cad_property is the deployment-store CAD table living_area was counted on. Atom bodies are what the bake actually reads. A field in one and not the other is itself a finding.

areaSweepRule: One chosen block per county (not random): consecutive place_key / entity_id range around the county gold, plus forced-in hard classes (PDD 48021:8720522, gate-blocked Williamson gold, no-row Travis gold, five- and seven-digit ids, unincorporated if present in the block).

falsifierPreregistered.livingAreaMatchesPremise: If cad_property living_area_sqft distinct-parcel coverage is not Hays 54.3 / Williamson 40.8 / Caldwell 27.7 / Bastrop 11.2 / McLennan 0 / Travis 0, the card's worked example is stale and the table says so.
falsifierPreregistered.bastropImprovementZero: If Bastrop stored-zero improvement values are not ~26553, the zero-vs-absent premise is wrong.
falsifierPreregistered.livingAreaStoredZeros: If living_area_sqft has any stored zeros, the card's 'no stored zeros at all' line is wrong.
falsifierPreregistered.serveTableWrong: If a live /facets body for 48021:34137 does not match place_layer_snapshots.payload_json at place_key=node:48021:34137 adapter node-facets:tier1, we measured the wrong serve table.
falsifierPreregistered.tenantScope: If entity_id-range n_roll disagrees with a tenant-scoped count, that is the expected 72-atom gap, not a finding against this card.
falsifierPreregistered.convenientCoverage: A field that is 100 percent present in every county on both sides is treated as an instrument defect until a known-absent county or a known-null key fails the same predicate.

heavyScanPlan: One heavy operation at a time. (1) information_schema on both DBs. (2) atom key DISTINCT per county. (3) cad_property per-column per-county counts. (4) place_layer_snapshots nested-key DISTINCT then per-key per-county counts. (5) pipeline-word scan. (6) live golds + area sweep. Announce each before it starts.

adversarial.risk1: A remembered CAD column list would miss the fields this card exists to surface. Mitigation: information_schema + jsonb_object_keys only.
adversarial.risk2: Global aggregation hiding Travis/McLennan zeros. Mitigation: GROUP BY fips on every query; no cross-county rollup in the deliverable.
adversarial.risk3: Presence-shaped counts passing pipeline words. Mitigation: fifth check enumerates unmeasured/unresolved/pending/unknown values, not just IS NOT NULL.
adversarial.risk4: Collapsing stored zero into absent. Mitigation: numeric fields report nonempty, stored-zero, and null as three columns.
